article_content: 'A significant discount on Cathedral City cheese caused a shopping frenzy at Tesco stores across the UK.  Twin packs, ordinarily costing £6.55, were being rung up for a mere £1.  The news, originally highlighted by Martin Lewis' Money Saving Expert website as a potential pricing error, spread like wildfire.  Customers rushed to fill their baskets, boasting about their bargain buys on social media and online forums.  Images of overflowing refrigerators packed with the discounted cheese quickly circulated.  Despite initial reports of a 'glitch,' Tesco clarified that the £1 price tag was a promotional offer launched earlier in the week. While some stores reverted to the original price, others continued to honor the deal, leading to further shopping excitement while supplies lasted.'

article_content: Nineteen-year-old Samuel Frappier was rescued Wednesday evening after spending a freezing night stranded 13,000 feet up Colorado's Longs Peak. The inexperienced climber, wearing only cotton clothes and tennis shoes, became separated from his friend Tuesday night and found himself stuck in a precarious position. He contacted Rocky Mountain National Park officials, but his phone died before rescuers could reach him.  A 28-person team launched a major rescue operation, locating Frappier around 6 p.m. Wednesday.  He was then transported by helicopter to a hospital for evaluation and appeared to be in good condition.  Frappier, a Quebec, Canada native, admitted to reporters he was 'stupid' for getting stuck and felt 'lucky' to be alive.

Va contactar amb els funcionaris del Parc Nacional de les Muntanyes Rocalloses, però el seu telèfon es va quedar sense bateria abans que els rescatadors poguessin arribar-hi. Un equip de 28 persones va iniciar una important operació de rescat, localitzant en Frappier al voltant de les 6 de la tarda de dimecres. Després va ser transportat en helicòpter a un hospital per a ser avaluat i semblava estar en bon estat. En Frappier, originari de Quebec, Canadà, va admetre als periodistes que va ser 'estúpid' per quedar-se encallat i es va sentir 'afortunat' d'estar viu.

article_content: In a heartbreaking incident late Sunday night, a homeless man tragically lost his life in an elevator shaft at San Francisco's Montgomery Street BART station.  Around 9:30 p.m., a passenger summoning the elevator reported hearing a scream and a crunching sound before the elevator abruptly stopped.  Upon investigation, authorities discovered the deceased man on top of the elevator, along with his belongings and what appeared to be bedding.  BART officials expressed shock and sadness, stating that such an incident is unprecedented in their four decades of operation.  The access point to the elevator shaft remains a mystery. While there are ventilation shafts and a hatch on the elevator itself, both present significant challenges for entry.  The ventilation shafts have been inspected and found secure, while the hatch seemingly requires assistance to open. Authorities are continuing their investigation into the circumstances surrounding this tragic event.  BART spokeswoman Luna Salaver stated that regular sweeps of the stations are conducted before closing to assist those experiencing homelessness, who typically seek shelter outside the station gates. In response to the tragedy, BART crews are inspecting elevator shafts at other downtown San Francisco stations to ensure public safety. The Montgomery Street station elevator remains out of service.

article_content: Phnom Penh, Cambodia (CNN) -- Nearly 100 Thai soldiers entered Cambodian territory on Wednesday near the disputed Preah Vihear temple, the site of prior clashes, Cambodian officials stated. The Thai army denied the incursion.  According to Phay Siphan, secretary of the Cambodian Council of Ministers, Thai soldiers entered the 11th-century temple area around 1:40 p.m.  No fighting occurred, and Cambodia requested Thailand withdraw its troops. Thai Army Colonel Sansern Kaewkumnerd stated the troop movement was a standard rotation and that Thai soldiers remained within permitted zones. The temple's ownership and surrounding land have been a source of ongoing contention. The nations disagree on the territorial boundaries around the temple.  Both countries deployed troops after the UN designated Preah Vihear a World Heritage Site in July.  Located atop a cliff on Cambodian soil, the temple's main entrance is on the Thai side.  The International Court of Justice awarded the temple to Cambodia in 1962. However, Thailand asserts the surrounding 4.6 sq. km area was never formally demarcated.  The UN's decision heightened existing tensions. Last year, tensions flared when Cambodian guards briefly detained three Thais who crossed into the disputed area and subsequently refused to leave. -- Reporting contributed by CNN's Tim Schwarz in Phnom Penh and Kocha Olarn in Bangkok.

L'exèrcit tailandès va negar la incursió. Segons Phay Siphan, secretari del Consell de Ministres de Cambodja, els soldats tailandesos van entrar a la zona del temple del segle XI cap a la 1:40 p.m. No hi va haver combats, i Cambodja va demanar a Tailàndia que retirés les seves tropes. El coronel de l'exèrcit tailandès Sansern Kaewkumnerd va declarar que el moviment de tropes era una rotació estàndard i que els soldats tailandesos van romandre dins de les zones permeses. La propietat del temple i els terrenys circumdants han estat una font de controvèrsia contínua. Les nacions no es posen d'acord sobre els límits territorials al voltant del temple. Ambdós països van desplegar tropes després que l'ONU designés Preah Vihear com a Patrimoni de la Humanitat al juliol. Situat al cim d'un penya-segat en sòl cambodjà, l'entrada principal del temple es troba al costat tailandès. El Tribunal Internacional de Justícia va atorgar el temple a Cambodja el 1962. No obstant això, Tailàndia afirma que l'àrea circumdant de 4,6 km quadrats mai va ser delimitada formalment. La decisió de l'ONU va augmentar les tensions existents. L'any passat, les tensions van augmentar quan els guàrdies cambodjans van detenir breument tres tailandesos que van creuar a la zona disputada i posteriorment es van negar a marxar. -- Informació proporcionada per Tim Schwarz de la CNN a Phnom Penh i Kocha Olarn a Bangkok.

article_content: 'Poverty has been increasing in American suburbs over the last two decades. The COVID-19 pandemic accelerated the trend of suburban poverty rising faster than urban poverty, according to new US Census data.  Between 2019 and 2022, the number of people living in poverty in the US grew by approximately 1.5 million to nearly 41 million, raising the national poverty rate to 12.6%, up from 12.3% in 2019, as per the Census Bureau's American Community Survey. The Brookings Institution found that the population living in poverty in major metro suburbs grew three times faster than in major cities during the same period. Over 60% of the national increase in poverty occurred in the suburbs.  Nearly half of all Americans (47%) live in suburbs, making them the most common type of residence. In comparison, 21% live in major cities (over 500,000 residents), 18% in small and medium-sized metro areas, and 14% in rural areas.  Brookings identified suburban communities within major metro areas of the South, West, and Midwest – such as those around Washington, D.C., Houston, San Francisco, Ogden, Utah, St. Louis, and Minneapolis-Saint Paul – as experiencing some of the largest increases in poverty. While no suburban community in a major metro area saw its impoverished population decrease between 2019 and 2022, some experienced growth in higher-income residents, thus lowering their overall poverty rates.  Despite the rising rates, suburbs remain among the wealthiest communities in the country. Although suburban poverty is increasing faster, cities still have a higher average poverty rate. In 2022, 9.6% of suburban residents lived in poverty, compared to 16.2% of major city residents, according to Brookings. Several factors contribute to this shift in poverty demographics, including rising urban housing costs.  Increased demand from affluent individuals moving into cities over the last two decades has driven up rents and home prices, creating an affordability crisis. This, further exacerbated in recent years, has pushed lower-income individuals towards the suburbs. Suburban communities have also diversified and attracted jobs, including low-wage positions, which have increasingly moved outside urban centers. This rise in suburban poverty presents challenges for many suburban areas, which often lack robust public transit, a strong network of non-profit support for low-income residents, and well-funded social services.'
translated_content: 'La pobresa ha anat augmentant als suburbis americans durant les últimes dues dècades. La pandèmia de la COVID-19 va accelerar la tendència de la pobresa suburbana a augmentar més ràpidament que la pobresa urbana, segons les noves dades del cens dels EUA. Entre el 2019 i el 2022, el nombre de persones que vivien en la pobresa als EUA va augmentar en aproximadament 1,5 milions fins a gairebé 41 milions, cosa que va elevar la taxa de pobresa nacional al 12,6%, en comparació amb el 12,3% del 2019, segons l'Enquesta de la Comunitat Americana de l'Oficina del Cens. La Brookings Institution va trobar que la població que viu en la pobresa als suburbis de les principals àrees metropolitanes va créixer tres vegades més ràpid que a les grans ciutats durant el mateix període. Més del 60% de l'augment nacional de la pobresa es va produir als suburbis. Gairebé la meitat dels nord-americans (47%) viuen als suburbis, cosa que els converteix en el tipus de residència més comú. En comparació, el 21% viu a grans ciutats (més de 500.000 habitants), el 18% a àrees metropolitanes petites i mitjanes i el 14% a zones rurals. Brookings va identificar comunitats suburbanes dins de les principals àrees metropolitanes del sud, oest i mig oest, com les que envolten Washington, D.C., Houston, San Francisco, Ogden (Utah), St. Louis i Minneapolis-Saint Paul, com les que van experimentar alguns dels majors augments de la pobresa. Si bé cap comunitat suburbana d'una àrea metropolitana important va veure disminuir la seva població empobrida entre el 2019 i el 2022, algunes van experimentar un creixement de residents amb ingressos més alts, cosa que va reduir les seves taxes de pobresa generals. Malgrat l'augment de les taxes, els suburbis continuen sent de les comunitats més riques del país. Tot i que la pobresa suburbana augmenta més ràpidament, les ciutats encara tenen una taxa de pobresa mitjana més alta. El 2022, el 9,6% dels residents suburbans vivien en la pobresa, en comparació amb el 16,2% dels residents de les grans ciutats, segons Brookings. Diversos factors contribueixen a aquest canvi en la demografia de la pobresa, inclòs l'augment dels costos de l'habitatge urbà. L'augment de la demanda de persones benestants que es traslladen a les ciutats durant les últimes dues dècades ha fet pujar els lloguers i els preus dels habitatges, cosa que ha creat una crisi d'assequibilitat. Això, agreujat encara més en els últims anys, ha empès les persones amb ingressos més baixos cap als suburbis. Les comunitats suburbanes també s'han diversificat i han atret llocs de treball, incloses les posicions de baix salari, que s'han traslladat cada cop més fora dels nuclis urbans. Aquest augment de la pobresa suburbana planteja reptes per a moltes zones suburbanes, que sovint no tenen un transport públic robust, una xarxa sòlida d'organitzacions sense ànim de lucre que ajudin les persones amb baixos ingressos i serveis socials ben finançats.'

article_content: CNN's Patrick Oppmann recently offered Seattle, Washington travel suggestions.  CNN.com readers shared their insights as the city anticipates summer. 'Summer brings vibrant GREEN against blue skies, water, mountains, and lush greenery,' wrote 1k9m8c1.  Sunshine replaces rain, 'trading parkas for sandals, revealing sun-starved skin.'  Here are reader tips for Seattle's summer awakening:  Best Views: For affordable city views, skip the Space Needle and try the Columbia Tower downtown.  'Better view, better price, less crowded!'  For sunsets, Salty's on Alki offers 'spectacular reflections off downtown buildings,' according to Yogababy.  DaveinIndy suggests the Bainbridge Ferry across Puget Sound. Best Bites: Tom Douglas' restaurants are popular. CM2BTHD recommends Lola for breakfast ('...so many potatoes!'), Dahlia Lounge, Palace Kitchen, Serious Pie, and Dahlia Bakery.  Kakash suggests Buenos Aires for tango and entertainment.  Andman favors Pasta Freska, where owner Mike creates personalized dishes.  Frommet recommends the 5 Spot in Queen Anne for brunch and Top Pot Doughnuts (skip the coffee).  Washington wines like Hedges, Chateau St. Michelle, and Columbia Crest impress. Outdoors: DaveinIndy recommends day trips to Mount Rainier or Olympic National Park.  'Rainier is majestic,' he says.

article_content: In September 2013, 27-year-old Terri-Ann Harrington, a single mother, received a four-year prison sentence for causing a fatal car accident that claimed the lives of two Stoke City fans, Martin Wilson (26) and James Morgan (20).  Harrington, driving her Renault Clio, lost control and crashed into a garden while under the influence of alcohol and cocaine.  Her blood alcohol level was more than twice the legal limit.  Tragically, both passengers, friends of Harrington, died instantly.  Following the crash, Harrington left the scene and was later discovered unconscious on a nearby road.  Toxicology reports indicated the presence of cocaine and opiates in her system.  Prior to the incident, Harrington had a history of drug-related offenses and had received judicial warnings regarding her substance abuse.  She had been cautioned about the risk of 'early death' due to her ongoing use of Class A drugs, including heroin.  The court heard that on the night of the accident, Harrington had been out with Wilson, her former partner, and Morgan, visiting several pubs after a family meal.  The crash occurred in the early hours as they drove through Lightwood, Stoke-on-Trent. Harrington initially claimed to have hit black ice and only consumed a small amount of alcohol, but investigators found no evidence to support these claims.  Weeks after the tragedy, and even on the day of the victims' funerals, Harrington continued to engage in criminal activities, including shoplifting.  She pleaded guilty to causing death by careless driving while under the influence and received a driving ban. Judge David Fletcher addressed Harrington's decision to leave her friends in the wreckage, stating, 'You walked away. Let’s face it, you walked away leaving your friends dead.'  Harrington's lawyer stated she suffered nightmares about the accident and struggled with the guilt of causing her friends' deaths.  He also highlighted the impact of her imprisonment on her six-year-old daughter.  This four-year sentence will be added to a previous 15-month sentence for offenses committed after the crash, including handling stolen goods, theft, drug possession, and criminal damage.  In 2008, Harrington underwent drug rehabilitation following previous offenses, including burglarizing a vicarage.  At the time, a judge warned her about the potential consequences of returning to drug use.  Tributes poured in for the victims. James Morgan’s former deputy headteacher described him as 'pleasant, popular, polite, and likeable.'  His sister expressed the profound impact he had on people’s lives. Martin Wilson’s uncle also shared his grief, stating, 'Martin was loved by many, we will all miss him.'
translated_content: El setembre de 2013, Terri-Ann Harrington, una mare soltera de 27 anys, va ser condemnada a quatre anys de presó per causar un accident de cotxe mortal que va costar la vida a dos aficionats del Stoke City, Martin Wilson (26) i James Morgan (20). Harrington, conduint el seu Renault Clio, va perdre el control i es va estavellar contra un jardí sota la influència de l'alcohol i la cocaïna. El seu nivell d'alcoholèmia era més del doble del límit legal. Tràgicament, els dos passatgers, amics de Harrington, van morir a l'instant. Després de l'accident, Harrington va abandonar l'escena i va ser trobada inconscient en una carretera propera. Els informes toxicològics van indicar la presència de cocaïna i opiacis en el seu sistema. Abans de l'incident, Harrington tenia antecedents d'infraccions relacionades amb les drogues i havia rebut advertències judicials sobre el seu abús de substàncies. Se l'havia advertit sobre el risc de 'mort prematura' a causa del seu ús continu de drogues de classe A, inclosa l'heroïna. El tribunal va saber que la nit de l'accident, Harrington havia sortit amb Wilson, la seva exparella, i Morgan, visitant diversos pubs després d'un sopar familiar. L'accident es va produir a primera hora del matí mentre conduïen per Lightwood, Stoke-on-Trent. Inicialment, Harrington va afirmar haver xocat amb gel negre i haver consumit només una petita quantitat d'alcohol, però els investigadors no van trobar proves que recolzessin aquestes afirmacions. Setmanes després de la tragèdia, i fins i tot el dia dels funerals de les víctimes, Harrington va continuar participant en activitats delictives, incloent robatoris a botigues. Es va declarar culpable de causar la mort per conducció negligent sota els efectes de l'alcohol i les drogues i va rebre una prohibició de conduir. El jutge David Fletcher va criticar la decisió de Harrington d'abandonar els seus amics entre els enderrocs, dient: 'Vas marxar. Siguem sincers, vas marxar deixant els teus amics morts'. L'advocat de Harrington va declarar que patia malsons sobre l'accident i lluitava contra la culpa de causar la mort dels seus amics. També va destacar l'impacte del seu empresonament en la seva filla de sis anys. Aquesta condemna de quatre anys se sumarà a una condemna anterior de 15 mesos per delictes comesos després de l'accident, inclosa la receptació de béns robats, robatori, possessió de drogues i danys criminals. L'any 2008, Harrington va ser sotmesa a rehabilitació de drogues després d'infraccions anteriors, inclòs el robatori a una vicaria. En aquell moment, un jutge la va advertir sobre les possibles conseqüències de tornar a consumir drogues. Els homenatges van arribar a les víctimes. L'exsotsdirector de James Morgan el va descriure com a 'agradable, popular, educat i simpàtic'. La seva germana va expressar el profund impacte que va tenir en la vida de les persones. L'oncle de Martin Wilson també va compartir el seu dolor, dient: 'Martin era estimat per molts, tots el trobarem a faltar'.

article_content: 'The Church of England is facing declining attendance, with fewer than 800,000 worshippers on a typical Sunday. This represents a significant drop, with current numbers less than half of those in the 1960s. This decline mirrors a broader trend of fewer people identifying as Christian in the UK, as revealed by census data.  Despite the Church's efforts to modernize services and appeal to a wider audience, these initiatives haven't reversed the downward trend.  According to the Church's research, there's no easy fix, and retaining younger generations is vital for its future.  In 2012, usual Sunday attendance was recorded at 795,800, slightly down from the previous year. While the Church also tracks average weekly attendance (including those attending services on days other than Sunday), which was around 1.05 million in 2012, this metric also shows stagnation over the past decade. The 2011 census indicated a substantial decrease in the number of Christians in the UK, with a significant rise in those identifying as having no religion.'

Això representa una caiguda significativa, amb xifres actuals menys de la meitat de les dels anys seixanta. Aquesta disminució reflecteix una tendència més àmplia de menys persones que s'identifiquen com a cristianes al Regne Unit, tal com revelen les dades del cens. Malgrat els esforços de l'Església per modernitzar els serveis i atraure un públic més ampli, aquestes iniciatives no han revertit la tendència a la baixa. Segons la investigació de l'Església, no hi ha una solució fàcil i retenir les generacions més joves és vital per al seu futur. L'any 2012, l'assistència habitual de diumenge es va registrar en 795.800, lleugerament inferior a l'any anterior. El cens del 2011 va indicar una disminució substancial del nombre de cristians al Regne Unit, amb un augment significatiu dels que s'identifiquen com a no religiosos.'

article_content: A serving admiral, Vice Admiral Simon Lister, has criticized the Royal Navy's current state, citing government spending cuts as a key factor in its decline. He argues that the Navy is struggling with a shortage of skilled engineers, leading to an over-dependence on civilian contractors for repairs. This reliance, he claims, is eroding the Navy's internal expertise and self-sufficiency. Admiral Lister highlighted the strain on existing engineers due to the demanding operational schedule, leaving minimal time for essential maintenance. He points to the lack of trained personnel for operating equipment like the Type 23 towed sonar as a symptom of this wider problem. He also notes a decline in the readiness of ships and submarines, attributing this to delays in new submarine deliveries (like the Astute class) and the ageing of existing vessels. As evidence, Admiral Lister references HMS Trenchant's extended 333-day deployment, and the breakdown of HMS Dauntless, a £1 billion destroyer, which required emergency repairs after a power loss. Similar incidents have affected other vessels, including HMS Daring, requiring them to be towed to port for repairs. The admiral further criticized reduced investment in training and the increased reliance on civilians, contributing to a loss of skilled personnel within the Navy.  The Ministry of Defence acknowledges the difficulty in recruiting and retaining engineers, citing industry-wide shortages, and emphasizes its ongoing efforts to address the issue through incentives and training programs.

article_content: 'Iraqi Prime Minister Nuri al-Maliki announced on Wednesday his intention to hold meetings with Iraqi political leaders before the end of this month. The purpose of these meetings is to gauge their perspectives on the potential extension of the U.S. troop presence in Iraq beyond the currently scheduled December withdrawal date.  Speaking to reporters from his office, al-Maliki stressed the significance of this decision, stating, 'This is a major national issue that demands a national consensus.' When questioned about his personal stance on extending the deployment of U.S. forces, al-Maliki declined to provide a direct response. He emphasized the weight of the decision, saying, 'Entire nations have struggled with this, and you expect me to answer before achieving national unity? Let's move on.'  There are now approximately 46,000 American troops stationed in Iraq, a significant decrease from the peak of 171,000 in 2003.  A 2008 agreement signed between the Iraqi government and the Bush administration stipulates the full withdrawal of U.S. troops by the year's end. While Admiral Mike Mullen, Chairman of the U.S. Joint Chiefs of Staff, mentioned in April that Iraq hadn't formally requested a delay, he indicated openness to discussion, though stressed the need for prompt action.  Al-Maliki clarified that the White House requires a decision by August. The possibility of an extended American military presence has sparked controversy. Last month, the influential Shiite cleric, Muqtada al-Sadr, issued a statement, read by a representative, threatening to 'escalate armed resistance and reactivate the Mehdi Army' if U.S. forces remain beyond the agreed deadline. This reactivation would reverse the 2007 suspension of al-Sadr's militia. Al-Maliki responded to al-Sadr's declaration by encouraging him to present his arguments through proper channels. 'We must find common ground on points of agreement and disagreement,' he stated. However, the Prime Minister acknowledged the challenge of achieving full agreement, adding, 'If 70% or 80% of Iraqis support the extension, the minority should respect this decision.' He proposed that those opposing the majority view could choose to withdraw from the political process and act within legal and constitutional boundaries.'

Parlant amb els periodistes des del seu despatx, al-Maliki va subratllar la importància d'aquesta decisió, afirmant: 'Aquesta és una qüestió nacional important que exigeix un consens nacional.' Quan se li va preguntar sobre la seva postura personal sobre l'extensió del desplegament de les forces nord-americanes, al-Maliki es va negar a donar una resposta directa. Va emfatitzar el pes de la decisió, dient: 'Nacions senceres han lluitat amb això, i espereu que respongui abans d'aconseguir la unitat nacional? Passem a una altra cosa.' Actualment hi ha aproximadament 46.000 soldats nord-americans estacionats a l'Iraq, una disminució significativa respecte al màxim de 171.000 el 2003. Un acord del 2008 signat entre el govern iraquià i l'administració Bush estipula la retirada total de les tropes nord-americanes abans de finals d'any. Mentre que l'almirall Mike Mullen, president de l'Estat Major Conjunt dels Estats Units, va mencionar a l'abril que l'Iraq no havia sol·licitat formalment un ajornament, va indicar que estava obert a la discussió, tot i que va subratllar la necessitat d'actuar amb rapidesa. Al-Maliki va aclarir que la Casa Blanca necessita una decisió per a l'agost. La possibilitat d'una presència militar nord-americana prolongada ha generat controvèrsia. El mes passat, l'influent clergue xiïta, Muqtada al-Sadr, va emetre un comunicat, llegit per un representant, amenaçant amb 'intensificar la resistència armada i reactivar l'Exèrcit del Mahdi' si les forces nord-americanes romanen més enllà del termini acordat. Aquesta reactivació revertiria la suspensió del 2007 de la milícia d'al-Sadr. Al-Maliki va respondre a la declaració d'al-Sadr animant-lo a presentar els seus arguments pels canals adequats. 'Hem de trobar punts en comú sobre els punts d'acord i desacord', va afirmar. No obstant això, el primer ministre va reconèixer el repte d'aconseguir un acord total, i va afegir: 'Si el 70% o el 80% dels iraquians donen suport a l'extensió, la minoria ha de respectar aquesta decisió.' Va proposar que els que s'oposen a l'opinió de la majoria podrien optar per retirar-se del procés polític i actuar dins dels límits legals i constitucionals.'

article_content: 'Michael J. Fox's return to NBC with 'The Michael J. Fox Show' has unfortunately been cut short.  The network confirmed Wednesday that the show has been canceled and will be replaced on Thursdays by 'Hollywood Game Night'.  Only 15 of the planned 22 episodes have aired so far, with no confirmation on when or if the remaining episodes will be broadcast.  This marks an early end to the much-anticipated series for the actor, previously known for his roles on 'Family Ties' and 'Spin City'.  'Sean Saves the World', also previously canceled, has been removed from the Thursday night schedule as well.  NBC chairman Robert Greenblatt expressed his disappointment with 'The Michael J. Fox Show's' ratings last month, acknowledging the show's struggles.  This news comes from Entertainment Weekly.'

article_content: In a bizarre incident early Saturday morning in Manchester's Fallowfield district, a man waiting at a bus stop on Wilmslow Road had his pizza snatched from his hands by a passenger in a passing car.  The perpetrators filmed the act and shared it online.  The video shows the car slowing down, a man leaning out the window, grabbing the pizza, and the car speeding off. The occupants are heard laughing, with one exclaiming, 'It's a whole pizza!'  28-year-old Dan Jackson from nearby Heald Green, identified as the pizza snatcher, admitted to the deed. He explained that he and his friends were driving home after celebrating a birthday and saw the man holding the pizza 'like a waiter,' finding the situation too tempting to resist.  Although Jackson later delivered a replacement pizza worth £12.95 to the victim's home, claiming the act was meant as a harmless prank, Greater Manchester Police condemned the incident.  A police spokesperson emphasized the danger of ignoring traffic lights, as seen in the video, stating that such actions can have serious repercussions and are 'no laughing matter.'

Els autors van filmar l'acte i el van compartir en línia. El vídeo mostra el cotxe reduint la velocitat, un home que s'inclina per la finestra, agafa la pizza i el cotxe que s'allunya a tota velocitat. Se sent riure els ocupants, i un exclama: 'És una pizza sencera!'. Dan Jackson, de 28 anys, de Heald Green, identificat com el lladre de la pizza, va admetre l'acte. Va explicar que ell i els seus amics tornaven a casa després de celebrar un aniversari i van veure l'home sostenint la pizza 'com un cambrer', trobant la situació massa temptadora per resistir-se. Tot i que Jackson va lliurar posteriorment una pizza de recanvi per valor de 12,95 lliures a casa de la víctima, al·legant que l'acte era una broma inofensiva, la policia del Gran Manchester va condemnar l'incident. Un portaveu de la policia va emfatitzar el perill d'ignorar els semàfors, com es veu al vídeo, afirmant que aquestes accions poden tenir repercussions greus i 'no són cap broma'.

article_content: A former Texas teacher, Kathryn Camille Murray, has pleaded guilty to charges related to a sexual relationship with a 15-year-old student. Murray, 29, admitted to improper relations with a student and sexual assault of a child. Two other charges were dropped. The incidents began in February 2012 when Murray, then an eighth-grade language arts teacher at Memorial Middle School in Houston, engaged in sexual acts with the student, whom she was supposed to be tutoring. The encounters occurred at the student's home, in Murray's classroom, and at a hotel room following a school dance. After being fired from her position, Murray continued contact with the student, leading to a charge of harboring a runaway in January 2013 when police found the teenager at her father's residence.  Murray will be sentenced on January 31, 2014. The school district is pursuing punishment for Murray, while the student's parents consider their son a victim.  The boy had previously expressed feelings for Murray.
